question: What effect does daily non-eating have on age and death?
premises: Daily non-eating is specified as the means
Age and death are named together
inference: Through daily non-eating, one will go beyond age and death.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with vayo mṛtyuṃ may mean reaching or transcending death
plain_english: By not eating for a day, one will overcome age and death.
